name: Dense Vector Retrieval
mechanism: Encodes queries and passages into a shared vector space and retrieves approximate nearest neighbors by embedding similarity.
use_when: Paraphrases and vocabulary mismatch cause lexical recall failures
The corpus language and domain are covered by a versioned embedding model
avoid_when: Exact identifiers dominate and dense retrieval loses their distinctions
Embedding versions or index builds cannot be reproduced and rolled back
expected_effects: Retrieval across vocabulary variation without query-time generation
failure_modes: Embedding drift requires a full index migration
required_evals: Recall@k by semantic and exact-query slice
